twenty_year.method: daily-bar proxy of the morning call, walked forward; the 5% news leg is 0 and there is no option chain; regressions refit every 20 sessions on a trailing 250; trades scored on O/H/L/C. Headline figures let the close decide when the order of stop/target touches is unknown; 'conservative' counts any stop touch, 'optimistic' counts a stop only when the day closes through it. The random baseline runs the identical geometry with the daily scores shuffled.

research.note: Every row uses the same 59-session walk-forward inputs as the main test and the same plan variant; only the named thing changes. 'passes' applies the full gate against a shuffled-score baseline (weights rows only). Rows without a baseline are compared with the 'as tested' row.

breakout_1r.description: break of the opening range in the scored direction; stop ≤ 0.35 ATR; target 1R then 2R

breakout_2r.description: break of the opening range in the scored direction; stop ≤ 0.35 ATR; target 2R then 3R

direction_hold.description: enter at the lock price in the scored direction; stop 0.35 ATR; no target — hold to the close

direction_1_5r.description: enter at the lock price in the scored direction; stop 0.35 ATR; target 1.5R then 3R

direction_2r.description: enter at the lock price in the scored direction; stop 0.35 ATR; target 2R then 3R

checks: net R 24.04 vs random 7.34 (must beat random)
t-stat 2.14 (need 2.0: average trade at least two standard errors above zero)
average win 124.7 vs average loss -73.8 pts (need wins ≥ 1.5x losses)

action_backtest.method: walk-forward over the available 5-minute history; locked at 09:35 with data up to then; the same direction score is traded five ways (opening-range break or entry at the lock; 1R/1.5R/2R targets or hold to the close), risk capped at 0.35 daily ATR; scored on 5-minute bars (same-bar stop/target conflicts count as a stop); baseline = same plans with the daily scores shuffled; only a variant whose first target is at least 2R (or that holds to the close) may be shown, and only if it clears every gate check
